component.name: pstview
component.summary: Read-only viewer and exporter for Outlook PST / OST and MBOX mailboxes

description.p: pstview opens Outlook PST and OST files (including Outlook 2013+ OSTs and mailboxes exported in several parts) and MBOX mailboxes from Google Takeout, Thunderbird and Apple Mail, without write access: nothing is written next to the source.

ul.li: Folder tree, sortable and searchable message list, reading pane
Header analysis: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, spoofing and delivery path, offline
Export as .msg, .eml or a whole mailbox as PST, with HTML and CSV reports recording the source's SHA-256
Recovery of deleted items and block-level integrity checks

description.p: Messages are shown with scripts and all network access blocked.

screenshot.caption: A mailbox with the header analysis of a spoofed message
